tex_content.html:
$(C_{\mathcal E},g_{\mathcal E})$ is a metric cone that is not homeomorphic to a ray.

Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:multiple-directions-at-end By construction $(C_{\mathcal E},g_{\mathcal E})$ is a metric cone. That it is not homeomorphic to a ray follows immediately from Lemma 4.1.
